The king said, “Who is in the court?” Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king’s house, to speak to the king…

He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.
For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the lawyer of this world? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this…
With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.

translations.web: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
translations.bsb: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and sweeps away the plans of the cunning.
translations.kjv: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
translations.asv: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; And the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
